basis: The two independence properties are enforced by an allow-list checked at assembly time, and are tested as errors rather than as properties of generated text.
Deterministic gates re-run by the Governor on the exact candidate; the loop refused the candidate once for an undeclared path and the packet scope was amended rather than the check bypassed.
Every supplied context item is accounted for in the manifest as included or dropped.
design_notes: Budget is measured in characters, not tokens. Tokens are what cost money, but every tokenizer is model-specific, and a context that hashes differently after a provider swap cannot be replayed by an audit. The receipt records the unit so a later routing model can recalibrate.

Forbidden sources raise rather than being filtered out. Silent filtering would leave a caller believing the Auditor saw something it did not, or that a leak was impossible when it was merely tidied away.
Budget fill is greedy in caller-supplied order. It is the only rule that is both obvious to a reader and reproducible by a replay; the caller knows what matters most for its packet.
residual_risk: Default budgets are guesses. They are round numbers chosen to be plausible, not measurements, and nothing yet validates them against real traces.
The character proxy will diverge from token cost unevenly across languages and content types; a repository slice and a requirement of equal length do not cost the same.

The engine is additive and unwired. Nothing yet forces a caller to use it, so the independence guarantees protect only the callers that opt in — wiring it into the loop is a protected-surface change and was deliberately excluded from this packet.
Candidate binding for completed packets is no longer re-checked against the live tree. Ledger chain integrity still is, for every stream, but a completed packet's tree binding is now historical.
discovery_candidates: OBS-SPD-002-evidence-ages: a candidate binding is true at a moment, not forever. A later packet may legitimately change files an earlier audit covered, and the only ways to keep re-checking it are to rewrite the completed audit or to report a failure that is really just elapsed time. Binding is a development-time gate; chain integrity is the permanent one.

OBS-SPD-002-scope-amendment-beats-scope-bypass: the loop refused a path this packet genuinely needed. Amending the packet document and re-running is cheap and leaves a record; widening the check would have left none.
